reply:
That changes it: localStorage is shared across all tabs of the same origin; sessionStorage is per-tab. Your flag in localStorage would sync to a second tab immediately, which explains the automatic login.

If the flag alone shouldn't trigger login (only other factors should), you need to either move the flag to sessionStorage, or check additional state that shouldn't have synced.
